standard_prerequisites.name: Minimal models of a curve, exceptional curves of the first kind and the birational classification of regular surfaces
standard_prerequisites.statement: A model of a smooth projective curve over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring is a flat proper scheme over the ring with that curve as generic fibre, and it is minimal when it admits no contraction to another model; the chapter proves that a minimal model always exists. Two exceptional curves of the first kind on a regular surface cannot meet, and a birational morphism between regular surfaces factors through the contraction of a finite sequence of such curves, a statement whose proof uses the classification of birational maps between regular surfaces. The author's own lemmas of the chapter and the three results of the Resolution of Surfaces chapter that the proof quotes are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the uniqueness statement that the chapter's chapter-level results on good reduction depend on, and it is quoted by the lemma on the existence of a smooth model.

core_obligations: Assume two minimal models and compare them: since both are projective over the base and have the same generic fibre, they are birational to each other, so the birational classification of regular surfaces applies to the pair (source lines 5003-5010).

Factor the birational map: every birational morphism between regular surfaces factors as a sequence of contractions of exceptional curves of the first kind, so a morphism from one model to the other can be decomposed into such contractions, and the same holds in the other direction (source lines 5010-5030).

Use minimality to kill the contractions: if any contraction were needed on either side, the corresponding model would not be minimal, so all the contractions in the factorisation must be trivial; the lemma that two exceptional curves on a regular surface are disjoint is quoted to keep the contractions independent of one another (source lines 5030-5045).
Conclude uniqueness: the two models are therefore isomorphic over the base, which is exactly the asserted uniqueness (source lines 5045-5048).

proof_roadmap.step: Compare two minimal models and note they are birational.
Factor the birational map into contractions of exceptional curves.
Use minimality to force all contractions to be trivial.
Conclude that the two models are isomorphic.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-minimal-model-unique（源 4995-5000 行，证明 5002-5048 行，47 行）：设 C 是亏格 > 0 的光滑射影曲线且 H^0(C,O_C)=K，则 C 的极小模型唯一。关键操作不是例行核验：证明要把两个极小模型拉成**双有理**的一对（因为它们射影且共享一般纤维，5003-5010 行），再用「正则曲面间双有理态射可分解为第一类例外曲线的收缩序列」把双有理对应拆成两串收缩（5010-5030 行），随后用**极小性**把两串收缩都逼成空（5030-5045 行，其中引用「正则曲面上两条第一类例外曲线不相交」以保证各次收缩互不干扰），最后得到两个模型同构（5045-5048 行）。难点在于「分解为收缩」与「极小 ⇒ 无收缩」两条推理的方向要接得严丝合缝；原文位置在证明的 5003-5010、5010-5030、5030-5045、5045-5048 行。
